input: variants.vcf: the chromosome 21 records of the GRCh38 corpus with the chromosome column rewritten to the names the cache's chr_synonyms.txt links to 21: NC_000021.9 (RefSeq) on 71 records, CM000683.2 (GenBank) on 21 and chr21 on 36, so every record reaches the cache's 21 directory through the synonym table or the chr prefix; Ensembl VEP ran on its own cache, whose chr_synonyms.txt it reads, with no --synonyms flag
generator: the GRCh38 corpus's chromosome 21 records renamed and annotated with Ensembl VEP, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --k 1 --seed 1 --max-records 120 --cache <converted slice>; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 1, 21 and X slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP cache (the breakend mates of two records lie on 1 and X), which keeps the slice's chr_synonyms.txt lines naming 1, 21 or X; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify

user-synonyms-replace-cache-file.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --synonyms synonyms_chr_only.txt
user-synonyms-replace-cache-file.input: variants.vcf under a user synonyms file that links chr21 alone, so Ensembl VEP reads neither its cache's chr_synonyms.txt nor the accessions: the 36 chr21 records annotate and the 92 NC_000021.9 and CM000683.2 records are skipped with the warning the expected warnings file lists
